ownRead.statement:
## E22 — Thermodynamics of bouncing grains

**experiment · constraint / comparator · claims C3, C6.**

**Reported result:** Grain transport is measured on a heterogeneous, nonresonating vibrating plate; effective statistical and transport descriptions are studied.

**Already supplied:** A driven plate, heterogeneity and grains are provided.

**Limit of the RRG connection:** Vibration-induced transport is not by itself proof of resonance. The earlier document incorrectly grouped this study as an unqualified resonant-mode example.

**Source:** Devauchelle, Popović, Szymczak, Abramian & Lazarus (2026), *Physical Review E 114, 025420*. [DOI: 10.1103/zlsc-w7m4](https://doi.org/10.1103/zlsc-w7m4).

**Verification coverage:** Original-paper abstract on APS; no raw-data reanalysis. Checked 2026-10-02. APS publication date: 24 August 2026; later index/crawl dates are not used as publication dates.
